learning_objectives.en: Complete a booking record using an original training recording.
learning_objectives.vi: Điền thông tin đăng ký tham quan từ bản audio luyện tập gốc.

vocabulary.example_en: Residents raised concerns at the public hearing.
vocabulary.example_vi: Cư dân nêu quan ngại tại buổi điều trần công khai.

strategies.en: Replay at natural speed, write the evidence phrase, then compare with the full transcript. Do not read the transcript before first attempt.
strategies.vi: Nghe tốc độ tự nhiên, ghi cụm bằng chứng, đối chiếu transcript sau lần làm đầu. Không đọc transcript ngay từ đầu.

mini_review.en: Can I explain why an earlier number was rejected?
mini_review.vi: Tôi có chỉ ra được vì sao một con số ban đầu bị thay đổi không?

mini_review.en: Can I explain each number or name from an audio transcript?
mini_review.vi: Tôi có thể tìm con số hoặc tên đúng trong transcript?

audios.title: U01_Listening_1
audios.transcript:
Coordinator: Good morning, Eastbank Community Office. You’re speaking to Nina. How can I help?
Resident: Hello. I’m arranging a visit for a small group of postgraduate students. They’re studying transport design and would like to hear about the green corridor.
Coordinator: Of course. We run guided visits on Thursdays and Saturdays. The Thursday session begins at nine thirty, but the Saturday tour was recently moved. It now starts at ten fifteen, not ten o’clock as the old leaflet says.
Resident: Saturday at ten fifteen would suit us. Is the meeting point still the library annex?
Coordinator: It used to be. We now meet at the old freight depot, in Pavilion Room B, immediately behind the covered market. Please tell everyone not to wait at the library.
Resident: I’ll make that clear. We have twelve students and two tutors. Is fourteen people too many?
Coordinator: Fourteen is fine. The normal maximum is sixteen, although we can occasionally divide a bigger group. There’s no fee for educational groups, but you must book in advance.
Resident: That’s helpful. Do we need to bring any equipment?
Coordinator: A notebook is useful, and closed shoes are recommended because one short section of the path is still being resurfaced. You don’t need safety helmets. Please avoid umbrellas in the indoor demonstration area.
Resident: Will we see the monitoring equipment?
Coordinator: Yes, though it’s important to understand what the instruments actually measure. They record air temperature at two locations and count people using the walkway. They do not measure pollution directly.
Resident: Can the students speak with people who work in the market?
Coordinator: We can invite a market representative for a short question-and-answer session. Please send your questions by Wednesday afternoon. We originally requested them by Monday, but the deadline has been extended.
Resident: Great. One last thing: may we print the map on your website for the students?
Coordinator: Certainly, for this educational visit. The revised map was uploaded yesterday. It includes the entrance on Riverside Lane and the bicycle parking next to the east gate.
Resident: Thank you. I’ll register the group online this evening.
Coordinator: You’re welcome. We look forward to seeing you.

instruction.en: Play the supplied original practice MP3; complete notes without reading the transcript first.
instruction.vi: Nghe MP3 luyện tập mới được cung cấp, hoàn thành ghi chú; không đọc transcript trước.

questions.explanation_en: The resident selects Saturday after the coordinator contrasts the Thursday and Saturday schedules.
questions.explanation_vi: “Saturday at ten fifteen would suit us.”

questions.explanation_en: The leaflet said 10:00, but the coordinator corrects it to 10:15.
questions.explanation_vi: “It now starts at ten fifteen, not ten o’clock” – 10:15 hoặc ten fifteen.

questions.explanation_en: The meeting place moved from the library annex to Pavilion Room B.
questions.explanation_vi: “in Pavilion Room B, immediately behind the covered market”.

questions.prompt_en: Total number of people in the group: ______
questions.explanation_en: Twelve students plus two tutors makes fourteen people.

questions.prompt_vi: Số người tối đa thông thường trong một đoàn: ____
questions.explanation_en: The coordinator explicitly states the usual maximum is sixteen.
Closed shoes are advised because a section of path is being resurfaced.

questions.prompt_vi: Thiết bị KHÔNG trực tiếp đo ____
questions.explanation_en: The instruments record air temperature and pedestrian counts, but not pollution directly.

questions.prompt_vi: Hạn gửi câu hỏi: chiều thứ ____
questions.explanation_en: The deadline changed from Monday to Wednesday afternoon.
questions.explanation_vi: “by Wednesday afternoon” – Monday là hạn cũ (bẫy).

questions.prompt_en: Street with the entrance on the map: ______ Lane
questions.prompt_vi: Cổng vào trên bản đồ nằm ở đường ____ Lane
questions.explanation_en: The revised map identifies the entrance on Riverside Lane.

questions.prompt_en: Bicycle parking is next to the ______ gate.
questions.prompt_vi: Bãi đậu xe đạp cạnh cổng phía ____
questions.explanation_en: The bicycle parking is located next to the east gate.
questions.explanation_vi: “bicycle parking next to the east gate”.
